summary.text: Jessica Kusner-Kalarchik is a nonpartisan candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A registered nurse, she retired after 31 years of U.S. Army service.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Kusner-Kalarchik served in the U.S. Army from 1993 to 2023.
She earned a high school diploma from CMR High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Alaska Anchorage in 2013, and she works as a registered nurse.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up primarily in Montana, enlisted in the Army out of high school, and came to Alaska during her second enlistment as a paratrooper.

She said she has worked as a registered nurse for a decade, with experience in medical-surgical care, the operating room and as a Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner, and that she lives on a rural property east of Palmer.
In the same survey, Kusner-Kalarchik named rural infrastructure, rural health care access, and protecting the Permanent Fund while pursuing resource development as her three key campaign messages.
She advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary.
